title: "01_preprocessing"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```

```{r}
read.csv("../data/raw/crashes_raw.csv", nrows=5) |> names()
```

```{r}
# extract only needed columns to limit memory use, then standardize column names
raw <- data.table::fread(
  "../data/raw/crashes_raw.csv",
 select = c("CRASH DATE", "CRASH TIME",
             "NUMBER OF PERSONS INJURED", "NUMBER OF PERSONS KILLED",
             "NUMBER OF PEDESTRIANS INJURED", "NUMBER OF CYCLIST INJURED",
             "NUMBER OF MOTORIST INJURED",
             "CONTRIBUTING FACTOR VEHICLE 1", "VEHICLE TYPE CODE 1")
) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  rename(
    crash_date   = `CRASH DATE`,
    crash_time   = `CRASH TIME`,
    injured      = `NUMBER OF PERSONS INJURED`,
    killed       = `NUMBER OF PERSONS KILLED`,
    ped_injured  = `NUMBER OF PEDESTRIANS INJURED`,
    cyc_injured  = `NUMBER OF CYCLIST INJURED`,
    mot_injured  = `NUMBER OF MOTORIST INJURED`,
    factor       = `CONTRIBUTING FACTOR VEHICLE 1`,
    vehicle_type = `VEHICLE TYPE CODE 1`
  )
dim(raw)
head(raw)
```


```{r}
# format dates, group crashes by day, then count crashes and sum injuries/deaths per day
crash_ts <- raw |> 
  mutate(crash_date = as.Date(crash_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")) |> 
  group_by(day = crash_date) |> 
  summarise(
    crashes     = n(),
    injured     = sum(injured, na.rm = TRUE),
    killed      = sum(killed, na.rm = TRUE),
    ped_injured = sum(ped_injured, na.rm = TRUE),
    cyc_injured = sum(cyc_injured, na.rm = TRUE),
    mot_injured = sum(mot_injured, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = day)

autoplot(crash_ts)
```

```{r}
# check missing values in raw data
colSums(is.na(raw))
```

```{r}
# check date range
range(crash_ts$day)
```

```{r}
# check for missing days in the series
has_gaps(crash_ts)
```

```{r}
# observe the most recent days
tail(crash_ts, 10)
```

```{r}
# plot daily crashes
autoplot(crash_ts, crashes)
```

```{r}
# save daily series
write.csv(crash_ts, "../data/nyc_daily_crashes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
